l01.text: [excited] Hi! I'm Sofia! And this is my totally... normal... morning routine.

l01b.text: [deadpan] This is Gus. My best friend. He is a goose. [whispers] Don't ask.

l02.text: [cheerful] Every day, I wake up at seven o'clock.

l04.text: Wake up means... stop sleeping. Your eyes open!

l07.text: Wake up is your eyes. Get up... is your body!

l09.text: [suspicious] Hmm. This toothpaste tastes like... [disgusted] mayonnaise?!

l10.text: One tooth. Two teeth. [laughs] Not tooths!

l11.text: [happy] I take a shower. Every morning!

l13.text: We say: take a shower. Not... make a shower!

q01.text: [excited] Quick quiz! What do I do after the shower?

q02.text: A: get dressed. Or B: make breakfast?

q03.text: [happy] A! I get dressed. [laughs] Well... I try.

l16.text: Get dressed means... put on your clothes. [laughs] Correctly.

l19.text: Remember! Make breakfast... but take a shower.

l20.text: [dreamy] I always drink coffee in the morning...

l22.text: [excited] At eight o'clock, I leave the house! I'm not late today!

l25.text: [cheerful] Let's repeat my morning. Say it with me!

l26.text: [curious] What do YOU do first in the morning? Write it in the comments!
